$comment: QA's expected compatibility rule set: the 20 rule ids of docs/qa/test-plan.md §9.2 (v4), which are the 18 ids of test plan v3 plus cooler-socket and display-output (Hazem, 2026-10-02, phase-1-plan §6). tests/audit/compat-trace.mjs checks the engine's registry against this list and every rule's tests against its fields. Owner: qa-lead. A change here needs the same change in test plan §9.2 (tests/audit/compat-trace.test.mjs pins both) and the Director's approval, recorded in test plan §16.

fields.outcomes: Every status the rule returns for real, fully published data. Each needs at least one passing test of that kind: 'ok' is the positive test, and 'warn' and 'block' are the negative tests.
fields.numeric: The rule compares a number with a limit, so it needs 'boundary at', 'boundary inside' and 'boundary outside' tests (test plan §9.1).
fields.unknownData: The rule needs an 'unknown' test: a spec that is not published gives warn ('can't verify: <field> not published'), never ok (budget.json compatibility.unknownDataMustNotReturn).
fields.variants: Cases a decision requires to be told apart. Each needs at least one passing test of that kind whose description matches the pattern (case-insensitive).
fields.data: When the rule's test data exists (phase-1-plan §3): ready, or the work package it waits for.

rules.check: The CPU socket matches the board
The board's CPU support list includes the CPU
Whether the CPU needs a newer BIOS than the board shipped with, and whether the board has BIOS FlashBack

variants.why: phase-1-plan WP-E1: where the board has BIOS FlashBack, the warning gives the update steps
Hazem, 2026-10-02 (phase-1-plan §6.1): warn, not block; the warning names the BIOS version needed and tells the buyer to ask the retailer for a board already updated to it

rules.data: ready; the BIOS dates need WP-D1

rules.check: The kit's memory type (DDR4 or DDR5) matches the board
The kit's modules fit the board's DIMM slots
The kit's speed against the board's and the CPU's official speeds
The card's length against the case, per layout
The card's thickness against the board's slot spacing and the case's expansion slots
rules.data: the Terra's data is ready; the board slots need WP-D1

rules.check: The air cooler's height against the case, per layout
The RAM's height under the air cooler's overhang
The radiator's size and position against the case
The PSU's form factor against the case
The PSU's length against the case, per layout
The PSU's wattage against the estimated load, with transient headroom
A native 12V-2x6 where the card needs one, and enough 8-pin cables
The M.2 drive count against the board's slots, and lane-sharing side effects
The board's form factor against the case
A front USB-C port needs a USB-C header on the board
The cooler's mounting kit fits the CPU socket
A build with no graphics card needs a CPU with integrated graphics
